hero.badge: For churches and small groups in Indonesia
hero.title: Shepherd your people, not a spreadsheet.
hero.body: Gembala helps church leaders log small group attendance, know every member, and see who needs a follow-up this week — from a browser or straight from Telegram.
hero.note: Ready to use in 15 minutes. No install.

features.title: Everything a leader needs to care for their people
features.subtitle: Built with small group leaders, not accountants.

members.title: Tidy member data
members.body: Full profiles, photos, family, and attendance history in one place. Guests are tracked from their very first visit.

attendance.title: Small group attendance in 3 minutes
attendance.body: Weekly, biweekly, or monthly schedules. Mark present, excused, or absent with a single tap.

followup.title: Know who needs a follow-up
followup.body: Members who miss two meetings in a row automatically show up on the follow-up list.

tags.title: Tags for ministry and age group
tags.body: Group members however your church is structured: youth, region, ministry — anything.

invite.title: Invite leaders with scoped access
invite.body: Every leader only sees the members they're responsible for.

notes.title: Pastoral notes stay private
notes.body: Private notes are visible only to the author and the pastor. They never appear in lists or exports.

telegramSection.title: Log attendance as easily as sending a message
telegramSection.body: After small group, just type who showed up. The Gembala assistant understands everyday language, asks for confirmation before saving, and answers questions about your members.

list.log: Log attendance and add new guests from chat
list.ask: Ask who hasn't come in a while
list.notes: Write pastoral notes while they're still fresh

chat.ariaLabel: Example conversation with the Gembala assistant
chat.me1: Today's youth small group attendance: Budi, Sari, Dewi present. Andi excused, sick.
chat.bot1Present: ✓ Present: Budi Santoso, Sari Wijaya, Dewi Natalia
chat.me2: Yes. Who hasn't come in the last 2 weeks?

privacy.title: Member data is a trust, not an asset
privacy.body: Every church gets its own isolated data space. Leaders only see members matching the tags they've been given, and every change is logged.

isolated.title: Isolated per church
isolated.body: No other church can see your data — not even the Gembala team.

tags.title: Tag-based access
tags.body: A youth group leader only sees youth members. Nothing more.

safe.title: Safe when leaders change
safe.body: Access is revoked instantly — data and notes stay safe with the church.

verse.quote: I know my sheep and my sheep know me.

finalCta.title: Start shepherding better
finalCta.body: Create your church account, add your first small group, and log your first meeting today.
